text:
**Deforestation cannot be confirmed from the available evidence.** The asset experienced approximately 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021, or 2.23% of its area.

Most of that loss area—68.1 hectares—was mapped as planted forest. Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting or other stand replacement, so it does not by itself establish deforestation or a change in land use. The cause is unknown.
